content.title: About
content.content: Ryazhenka is a fermented dairy drink made from baked milk that is soured with lactic acid cultures. It has a delicate creamy color, a slightly sweet caramel-like flavor, and a mild tang. Ryazhenka is drunk cold, added to batter for pancakes and fritters, and used in baking and desserts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Ryazhenka is a traditional drink of the Eastern Slavs, popular in Ukraine, Russia, and Belarus.
The milk for ryazhenka is simmered for a long time at high heat until it takes on a creamy color and caramel flavor.
The fat content of ryazhenka is usually 2.5 to 4 percent.
Ryazhenka differs from kefir and yogurt in that it is made from baked milk.
Good ryazhenka contains live lactic acid cultures.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Calcium is needed for bones and teeth.

items.title: Contains protein
items.content: Milk protein supports muscles and helps you feel full.

items.title: Contains vitamin B12 and riboflavin
items.content: These vitamins support metabolism and the formation of blood cells.

items.title: Contains lactic acid bacteria
items.content: Live cultures in fermented foods support gut microflora.

items.title: Slightly less lactose
items.content: During fermentation some of the lactose is broken down, so some people tolerate it better than milk.

items.title: Lactose
items.content: Ryazhenka contains lactose, so it may not suit people with lactose intolerance.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Ryazhenka is not suitable for people with an allergy to cow's milk proteins.

items.title: Sugar and additives
items.content: Sweetened and flavored versions may contain a lot of added sugar.

items.title: Fat content
items.content: Ryazhenka is fattier than kefir, so portions should be moderate, especially with high cholesterol.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink ryazhenka cold, at breakfast or as a snack, add it to smoothies, and use it to make pancakes, fritters, baking batter, and desserts. It is better to choose ryazhenka without added sugar.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store ryazhenka in the refrigerator in a closed package and use it before the expiration date; after opening, within two to three days. Freezing is not recommended. Discard ryazhenka that is moldy or has an unusual smell.
